## 🚀 Feature Request

**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear description of what you want to happen.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A clear description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

---

## 📋 Technical Details

**Component/Feature Area:**
- [ ] Blog system
- [ ] Editor system
- [ ] Authentication
- [ ] Database
- [ ] Styling/UI
- [ ] Performance
- [ ] Security
- [ ] Deployment
- [ ] Other (specify): ___________

**Priority:**
- [ ] Low (nice to have)
- [ ] Medium (should have)
- [ ] High (must have)

**Impact:**
- [ ] User-facing
- [ ] Developer-facing
- [ ] Both

---

## 🎯 Implementation Suggestions

**How would you implement this feature?**
If you have ideas on how to implement this, describe them here.

**Dependencies:**
List any dependencies or prerequisites for this feature.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
What should be true for this feature to be considered complete?

---

## 📝 Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues and feature requests
- [ ] I have provided clear requirements and context
- [ ] I am willing to help implement this feature (optional)

---

**Note:** Feature requests are welcome! Please provide as much detail as possible to help us understand your needs.
